We are excited to share our participation in the 2025 Miami International Boat Show, taking place from February 12-16. This event, known as the Discover Boating Miami International Boat Show, transforms Miami into a premier destination for boating enthusiasts, featuring six exciting venues from Miami Beach to Downtown.

This year, we proudly join forces with our exclusive distributors, OKEAN Yachts and NHD Boats, at Herald Plaza. Be prepared to experience the groundbreaking design and signature open-side deck concept of OKEAN Yachts showcased in stunning in-water displays. Meanwhile, you can explore the unmatched craftsmanship and performance of NHD Boats with their open deck system, displayed on land.

With over 1,000 exhibitors and more than 1,000 boats on display, the Miami International Boat Show is the ultimate opportunity to immerse yourself in the latest industry trends, connect with experts, and experience the very best in the yachting world. Whether you’re a seasoned yacht owner or just beginning your journey into boating, this event is designed for everyone.
